Calendar.Preset.label: Calendar
Calendar.Preset.description: harvest: an invented eight-month farming calendar of 45-day months, the default. gregorian: the real-world months, without leap years. norse: the twelve Old Icelandic months, with the four-day summer week Sumarauki, and two seasons, winter and summer. japanese: the traditional Japanese month names, with four seasons. custom: the months and weekdays listed under Calendar in this mod's config file, which you edit by hand; if they're invalid, the server log says why and the harvest calendar is used instead.

Calendar.EpochYear.label: First year number
Calendar.EpochYear.description: The number of the calendar's first year. Negative years are allowed.

Calendar.YearLabel.label: Year label
Calendar.YearLabel.description: How a year is written. {year} is the number, for example "{year} AR".

Calendar.CustomMonths.label: Custom months
Calendar.CustomMonths.description: Used when Calendar is custom. Edit the config file: a list of { Name, Days, Season }.

Calendar.CustomWeekdays.label: Custom weekdays
Calendar.CustomWeekdays.description: Used when Calendar is custom. Edit the config file: a list of names.

Clock.Mode.label: Clock
Clock.Mode.description: world-days: the calendar turns at each sunrise in the world. real-time: it follows the real date.

Clock.CalendarDaysPerWorldDay.label: Calendar days per day
Clock.CalendarDaysPerWorldDay.description: 0.25: one calendar day every four in-game days. 4: four calendar days per in-game day. In real-time mode, per real day.

Clock.RealTimeEpochMillis.label: Real-time start (Unix ms)
Clock.RealTimeEpochMillis.description: Real-time mode only: the moment the calendar's first day began, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC). Each step is one day.

Clock.UtcOffsetHours.label: UTC offset (hours)
Clock.UtcOffsetHours.description: Real-time mode only: when the day changes. -5 for New York in winter, 5.75 for Nepal. Daylight saving time is not followed.

Display.DateFormat.label: Date format
Display.DateFormat.description: How /date and the announcements write the date. {monthName} is the month's name, {month} its number and {month2} its number with two digits. {day} and {day2} are the day of the month, {dayOfYear} the day of the year, {year} the year's number and {yearLabel} the year label. {weekday} and {season} appear only when their switches below are on, and {ordinal} adds st, nd, rd or th.

Display.ShowWeekday.label: Show weekday
Display.ShowWeekday.description: Adds the weekday in front of the date.

Display.ShowSeason.label: Show season
Display.ShowSeason.description: Adds the season after the date.

Display.Announce.AtDawn.label: Announce each dawn
Display.Announce.AtDawn.description: Sends the dawn message at every sunrise (in real-time mode, at local midnight).

Display.Announce.SeasonChange.label: Announce new seasons
Display.Announce.SeasonChange.description: Sends one line, such as "Summer has come.", on the first dawn of a new season.

Display.Announce.Template.label: Dawn message
Display.Announce.Template.description: {date} is the date, written with the date format above.
